title: A full-spectrum isotope mass witness is source-reported; the small-motif device case is withdrawn
status_authority: Exact receipt-selected source bytes and the later direct user instruction authorize this source intake. The record preserves producer-reported mathematical and model scope; no scientific review or status promotion was performed.
reported_status: The 17:44 source reports a full signed nuclear energy-moment identity for a stationary time-reversal-invariant state and a position-dependent scattering operator, then applies it in a specified harmonic graphene/coherent-electron model. It explicitly withdraws the small motif optical response as a device justification after a stationary single-label spatial-scan comparator reproduces most of the signal. The related 16:41 permutation and pilot results remain conditional. No transfer chemistry, calibrated reader, code/data package, experiment, priority, or practical advantage is established.
scientific_scope_status: Source-reported identity: integral E S_A(E) over the complete signed nuclear energy-transfer spectrum equals (hbar^2/2) sum_i <|grad_i A|^2>/M_i for a stationary, time-reversal-invariant nuclear state. The expectation still depends on the nuclear position distribution. In the specified 300 K in-plane harmonic graphene model, the two-label configuration yields conditional full-moment and one-phonon centroid shifts; at unchanged site b the 0.6766 meV two-label centroid shift is largely reproduced by the 0.7364 meV single-label spatial-scan comparator. The source withdraws that small motif as a materials-device rationale. Model predictions and operation counts are not acquired physical results.
